local_server_ssl.label: SSL (HTTPS)
local_server_ssl.description: Connect to the local server using SSL (HTTPS)

library_id.label: Library
library_id.description: The library to connect to (e.g. Music)

library_type.label: Library Type
library_type.description: Select whether this Plex library should be treated as Music, Audiobooks, or Podcasts.

import_collections.label: Import Collections
import_collections.description: Import collections (tracks, albums, or artists) as playlists

collection_prefix.label: Collection Prefix
collection_prefix.description: Prefix to add to collection names when imported as playlists

plex_like_rating.label: Plex rating when liking in Music Assistant
plex_like_rating.description: When you like a track or album in Music Assistant, set this rating value in Plex (0.0 = unrated, 10.0 = 5 stars).

plex_favorite_threshold.label: Minimum Plex rating to import as favorite
plex_favorite_threshold.description: Tracks and albums with a Plex rating at or above this threshold will be imported as favorites in Music Assistant (0.0 = unrated, 10.0 = 5 stars).

plex_unlike_rating.label: Plex rating when unliking in Music Assistant
plex_unlike_rating.description: When you unlike a track or album in Music Assistant, set this rating value in Plex (0.0 = unrated/clear rating, 10.0 = 5 stars).

hub_items_limit.label: Items per hub
hub_items_limit.description: Maximum number of items to load from each hub (default: 10)

gdm.label: Use Plex GDM to discover local servers
gdm.description: Enable "GDM" to discover local Plex servers automatically.
gdm.action_label: Use Plex GDM to discover local servers

auth_myplex.label: Authenticate with MyPlex
auth_myplex.description: Authenticate with MyPlex to access your library.

auth_local.label: Authenticate locally
auth_local.description: Authenticate locally to access your library.

manifest.description: Stream your personal music, podcasts, and radio via your Plex media server.
